lessons.title: Headless agents never wait
lessons.text: A saved postmortem describes two builds stopping before verification while returning a successful exit code. The proposed correction was synchronous verification and checking for the job record and review card after a worker exits. A later note also warned about background delegation.
lessons.boundary: This is a recorded failure and proposed operating rule, not a benchmark of recovery reliability.

lessons.title: Stop paying per-frame cost for things that never change
lessons.text: A saved research note proposes auditing static shadow updates, repeated material traversal and CPU-side particle updates. It also suggests shader prewarming. The Librarian proposed turning these observations into a reusable skill checklist.
lessons.boundary: Derived from an external case study. Its reported performance gains are not StudioHQ results.
